title: Scoped reviews and honest publication gates
description: Manual local native reviewer and gateway recovery proof. Set FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT for the owned browser; use a fresh artifact directory.

round-budget.intent: The gateway refuses stale approval without consuming the gate, records an extension, admits native sixth/seventh reviews and retains N/L through restart.

approval-outcome.intent: A zero-review policy still refuses stale proof before consuming approval; accepted approvals retain one exact-package decision through a private gateway restart.

maintenance-budget.intent: A feature PR spent at 5/5 still admits an update-branch request at 0/2; replay, third-round refusal, refunds and durable ownership preserve both budgets. This node starts no model or product run.
